review.notes: Literature review table of external cases from other authors; none is the 45-year-old Ethiopian man (p1). The 17/M Ethiopian row (Habtamu M et al., 2025, Kartagener syndrome) is a cited report and not p1 (p1 had Kartagener excluded).
limitations: The .doc was read via textutil text extraction, not a rendered page image.
review.content_class_rationale: Read the complete 1-page Word .doc (full text extracted with textutil, 203 words): a lead sentence plus a 7-column table (reference, year, country, age/sex, clinical presentation, diagnostic method, associated conditions) listing nine previously published African situs inversus totalis cases (2003-2025) with an abbreviation footnote.

estimated_counts.basis: Counted nine data rows (one with a blank reference cell, a continuation of Danbauchi) in the extracted table; page count from the document properties (Number of Pages: 1)

limitations: Reviewer opened every file (images viewed, PDFs rendered, .doc text extracted); content accuracy not independently measured.
